mapper.sql: room_number, room_type, rent_price, deposit_price, water_price, electricity_price, area, room_status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM rooms
ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT id, user_name, password, doc_number, phone_number, job, work_address, room_number, lease_start_date, lease_end_date, lease_status, create_time, update_time FROM user WHERE room_number = #{roomNumber} AND lease_status = '在租' ORDER BY lease_start_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rooms( room_number, room_type, rent_price, deposit_price, water_price, electricity_price, area, room_status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES( #{roomNumber}, #{roomType}, #{rentPrice}, #{depositPrice}, #{waterPrice}, #{electricityPrice}, #{area}, #{roomStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE rooms SET room_type = #{roomType}, rent_price = #{rentPrice}, deposit_price = #{depositPrice}, water_price = #{waterPrice}, electricity_price = #{electricityPrice}, area = #{area}, room_status = #{roomStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE room_number = #{roomNumber}
